prompts.eq:
This is an image of a dialog window or form.
Determine for EQ:
- DET: number of interface elements (fields, buttons, checkboxes, labels, lists)
- FTR: number of logical files/tables (usually 1-3)
Reply with ONLY JSON, no extra text:
{"det":0,"ftr":0,"explanation":"explanation"}

apiKeySetup.title: 🔑 OpenRouter API Key Setup
apiKeySetup.subtitle: AI image analysis requires a free OpenRouter key.
apiKeySetup.securityNote: The key is sent directly from your browser to OpenRouter and isn't stored anywhere — but that also means anyone with access to your device's network traffic could see it. Don't use keys with a paid limit on public or shared computers.
